subjectOptions: 48-unit Mission Valley multifamily at a 6.33% cap
emails.body:
{FIRST_NAME},

We've brought Hillcrest Gardens Apartments to market — 48 units in Mission Valley, asking $10,950,000 at a 6.33% cap on in-place income.

In-place rents are roughly 8% under market, and occupancy is 93.6%.

Reply and I'll send the OM today.

subjectOptions: The rent roll story at Hillcrest Gardens
emails.body:
{FIRST_NAME},

A number worth a second look: Hillcrest Gardens is priced at $228,125 per unit while in-place rents sit about 8% under market across both floor plans.

The OM is in circulation — happy to walk the rent roll with you.

{FIRST_NAME},

Are you underwriting Hillcrest Gardens? If there's a number you need to see supported, that's a 15-minute call.

Tours are running next week — Tuesday or Thursday work well.
